marker.claim: エージェント（Claude Code / Codex）が agent-wiki のページ 3 本を取得でき、本文の指紋が封印と一致する
marker.note: Ground truth: the harness fetches each sealed URL and compares the body sha256 with the sealed digest; a mismatch is a separate ground-truth row (the page changed), not an agent failure. Observation: the existing fetch-check (founder-ops .../fetch-check/run.cjs) writes <date>.json with fetched/denied/unclear/error per agent and page; this marker converts that summary into one reading per observer. Rules: any error = instrument; a wiki page denied or missing = stage_stopped discover; unclear = understand; all wiki pages fetched = done. The control page (existing insights article) is recorded as a check but does not move the stage. Codex runs are produced by Michie twice a week; days without a summary cell for an observer write no row for that observer.

goal_prompt.ja: （課題文は fetch-check/battery.json のもの。エージェントに URL をそのまま開かせ、title を返させる。検索はさせない。）
goal_prompt.en: (Prompt lives in fetch-check/battery.json: open the URL as given, return the title, no search.)

preconditions: Sealed file lists 3 URLs with body sha256 at sealing time (draft: exec-harness/draft-marker.mjs M-003)
fetch-check/run.cjs has produced <fetch_check_dir>/<today>.json before this marker runs
